items.label: Debit
items.description: An accounting entry posted on the debit side of a movement.

items.label: Credit
items.description: An accounting entry on the credit side or a positive balance in favor of the customer/student.

items.label: Balance
items.description: The final remaining amount after all debit and credit movements are applied.

items.label: Installment
items.description: A scheduled part of total fees within a payment plan.

items.label: Overdues
items.description: Amounts that remain unpaid after the due date has passed.

items.label: Reconciliation Entry
items.description: A separate adjustment document used after issue instead of editing an already issued financial report.
